img.cap: Astronaut Anil Menon takes a selfie during a spacewalk. His arms and the camera he's holding are visible in the reflection on his gold visor. Behind him, we can see Earth looming in the background.

p: NASA/Anil Menon NASA astronaut Anil Menon took this selfie during a spacewalk on Oct. 29, 2026. He and CSA (Canadian Space Agency) astronaut Joshua Kutryk installed a new roll-out solar array on the International Space Station.

p.t: Get daily updates from the space station.
